titre: Production de véhicules par région en 2025

Asie-Pacifique.texte: Production in the Asia-Pacific region rose 7.6% to around 59.2 million vehicles

Amériques.texte: Regional production declined 2.1% to 18.74 million vehicles, while sales rose 2.9% to 24.86 million

Europe.texte: Production slipped 0.8% to 17.2 million vehicles, while sales edged down 0.4% to 18.63 million
